'''Rhon Bes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who worked for the [[Contraband Resale Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]], when he sold embargoed items on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhon Bes was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], where he was the Embargoed Items vendor in Vaiken Spacedock's Cartel Bazaar. However, he was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
